# adds_gpo_links (Resource)

Manages the full, ordered set of GPO links on a single OU, domain or site, plus whether it blocks inheritance from above. This resource is **authoritative** for `target`: any link present in Active Directory but not listed in `links` is removed.

`links` order is significant: the first entry has the highest precedence (`Set-GPLink -Order 1`), matching how GPMC displays link order.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "adds_organizational_unit" "servers" {
  path = "Contoso/Servers"
}

resource "adds_backup_gpo" "baseline_workstation" {
  backup_name = "Baseline Workstation"
  path        = "${path.module}/backup_gpo"
  target_name = "Baseline Workstation"
}

resource "adds_backup_gpo" "screen_lock" {
  backup_name = "Screen Lock"
  path        = "${path.module}/backup_gpo"
  target_name = "Screen Lock"
}

# Authoritative for every GPO link on this OU: any link present in AD but not listed
# here is removed. Order matters - the first entry has the highest precedence.
resource "adds_gpo_links" "servers" {
  target            = adds_organizational_unit.servers.path
  block_inheritance = true

  links = [
    {
      gpo = adds_backup_gpo.screen_lock.id
    },
    {
      gpo      = adds_backup_gpo.baseline_workstation.id
      enforced = true
    },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `links` (Attributes List) GPO links on `target`, in precedence order (first entry wins conflicts). Any link on `target` not listed here is removed. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--links))
- `target` (String) OU, domain or site to manage links on. Accepts a slash-delimited path relative to the domain root (for example `Servers` or `Contoso/Servers`), a relative distinguished name such as `CN=Sites,CN=Configuration`, or a full distinguished name.

### Optional

- `block_inheritance` (Boolean) Block inheritance of GPOs linked above `target` in the Group Policy hierarchy (`Set-GPInheritance -IsBlocked`). Links enforced above `target` still apply regardless of this setting.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Terraform resource identifier. Equals `target_dn`.
- `target_dn` (String) Distinguished name of `target`.

<a id="nestedatt--links"></a>
### Nested Schema for `links`

Required:

- `gpo` (String) GPO to link, by GUID or display name.

Optional:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the link is enabled (`Set-GPLink -LinkEnabled`).
- `enforced` (Boolean) Whether the link is enforced, so it cannot be blocked or overridden at a lower level (`Set-GPLink -Enforced`).

Read-Only:

- `gpo_guid` (String) Resolved GUID of `gpo`.
- `gpo_name` (String) Resolved display name of `gpo`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# GPO links are imported by the target's distinguished name.
terraform import adds_gpo_links.servers "OU=Servers,OU=Contoso,DC=contoso,DC=com"
```
